devdoc.details: Implements a vault system per chain to collect and distribute fees. Uses oracle-based pricing to calculate fees based on gas costs.

collectPostClaimFee(uint256).details: Uses predefined gas amount for claim posting operations

returns.fee: The amount of fee collected in wei

collectSendFee(uint256).details: Uses predefined gas amount for send operations

returns.fee: The amount of fee collected in wei

createFeeVaultIfNeeded(uint256).details: Called when initializing new paths to ensure fee collection infrastructure exists

creditSendFee(bytes32,address).details: Tracks fees that bonders should receive for facilitating transfers. Uses current base fee to calculate credit amount, which will be distributed later via cross-chain messages.

distributeClaimedFees(bytes32,uint256,ad.details: Calculates new fees since last claim and transfers from the counterpart chain's vault. This enables bonders to claim fees they earned on other chains.

distributeExcessFees(uint256,address[],u.details: Allows the fee distributor to allocate surplus fees for protocol development, DAO treasury, or other purposes beyond bonder compensation.

getFee(uint256,uint256).details: Multiplies gas amount by oracle-provided price for the target chain

returns.fee: The calculated fee amount in wei

returns._0: The address of the EtherVault contract for the specified chain

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setFeeDistributor(address).details: Distributor manages allocation of excess fees beyond bonder compensation

setFeeOracle(address).details: Oracle is responsible for providing chain-specific gas price data

setFeePrice(uint256,uint256).details: Price represents the gas price multiplier used for fee calculations

setFeePrices(uint256[],uint256[]).details: Batch operation for efficient price updates across multiple chains

setGateway(address).details: Can only be set once to prevent unauthorized changes after deployment

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

devdoc.title: FeeManager

collectPostClaimFee(uint256).notice: Collects post claim fee from bonders when posting claims

collectSendFee(uint256).notice: Collects send fee from users when initiating transfers

createFeeVaultIfNeeded(uint256).notice: Creates a fee vault for a specific chain if it doesn't exist

creditSendFee(bytes32,address).notice: Credits send fees to bonders for later distribution (gateway operation)

distributeClaimedFees(bytes32,uint256,ad.notice: Distributes accumulated fees to bonders via cross-chain messages (gateway operation)

distributeExcessFees(uint256,address[],u.notice: Distributes excess fees from vaults to specified recipients (distributor operation)

getFee(uint256,uint256).notice: Calculates fee amount based on gas consumption and chain-specific pricing

getFeeVault(uint256).notice: Gets the fee vault address for a specific chain

getPostClaimFee().notice: Gets the fee required for posting claims on the current chain

getRemoveFee().notice: Gets the fee required for removing claims (same as post claim fee)

getSendFee(uint256).notice: Returns the fee covering fees credited to bonders when posting claims

setFeePrice(uint256,uint256).notice: Updates the fee price for a specific chain (oracle operation)

setFeePrices(uint256[],uint256[]).notice: Updates fee prices for multiple chains in a single transaction (oracle operation)

setPostClaimFeeGas(uint256).notice: Updates the gas amount used for post claim fee calculations

setSendFeeGas(uint256).notice: Updates the gas amount used for send fee calculations

userdoc.notice: Manages fee collection, distribution, and pricing across chains for the Rails bridge
